title: The physical world
subtitle: surface, climate, landscape, consists of, the north-east
summary: Describe the land, the weather and the size of a place, and say which part of a country somewhere is in.

lesson.heading: Facts about the Earth
lesson.text: The **Earth** is the planet we live on. The **surface** is its top or outside part. Two thirds of the surface of the Earth is **covered in** water.

examples.text: Two thirds of the **surface** of the **Earth** is **covered in** water.
The **Pacific** is the largest **ocean** in the world.
examples.note: It is nearly twice the size of the Atlantic Ocean.

examples.text: It takes the moon just under 28 days to go round the **Earth**.

lesson.heading: Record places
rows: the hottest place in the world - over 57 degrees Celsius
the coldest place on Earth - minus 89 degrees Celsius
the deepest cave in the world - over 2,000 metres deep
the longest canal in the world - 1,794 kilometres long
the highest waterfall in the world - 979 metres high
the largest rainforest in the world - it covers 40% of South America

lesson.heading: Three uses of cover
lesson.text: **Cover** can mean that something is over something else. It can also talk about the size of an area, or about the **distance** you travel.

examples.text: The Amazon rainforest **covers** 40% of South America.
We **covered** ten miles in one day.

lesson.heading: Geography words
lesson.text: A **region** is an area in a country or the world. A **landscape** is the appearance of an area of land. The **climate** is the weather conditions of a place. If something **consists of** three parts, it is made or formed from them.

examples.text: Mountains and lakes are typical of the **landscape** in Switzerland.
The **climate** can change within a very short **distance**.

left.label: Ascona, in the south
examples: The **temperature** is usually warm and pleasant.
It is sunny for much of the year.

right.label: the Dufour Peak, in Valais
examples: The **temperature** is well below zero at night.
The **distance** between the two places is just 70 kilometres.

lesson.heading: Parts of a country: Switzerland
lesson.note: The eight directions are north, north-east, east, south-east, south, south-west, west and north-west.

lesson.text: We say minus 10 degrees Celsius for a temperature below zero, and we write it as -10 degrees C.

exercises.prompt: Two thirds of the ___ of the Earth is covered in water.
exercises.explanation: The surface is the top or outside part of something.

exercises.prompt: The ___ we live on is called the Earth.
exercises.explanation: The Earth is the planet we live on.

exercises.prompt: The largest ocean in the world is the ___.
exercises.explanation: The Pacific is nearly twice the size of the Atlantic Ocean.

exercises.prompt: Match each place with what it is famous for.

pairs.right: the deepest cave in the world
the longest canal in the world
the highest waterfall in the world
the largest rainforest in the world
the hottest place in the world

exercises.prompt: In the autumn, the ground is ___ in leaves that have fallen off the trees.
exercises.explanation: Be covered in / with something = have it all over you.

exercises.prompt: You find this animal in the semi-desert ___ of Australia.
exercises.explanation: A region is an area in a country or the world.

exercises.prompt: Brazil is a country of ___: large empty areas inland, and cities near the coast.
exercises.explanation: A contrast is a big difference between two things.

exercises.prompt: Mountains and lakes are typical of the ___ in Switzerland.
exercises.hint: (the appearance of an area of land)
exercises.explanation: The landscape is what an area of land looks like.

exercises.prompt: People say Cape Town has a wonderful ___: sunny for much of the year, and never too hot or very cold.
exercises.explanation: The climate is the normal weather conditions of a place.

exercises.prompt: Switzerland ___ of three main geographical regions.
exercises.explanation: Consist of = be made or formed from.

exercises.prompt: It was a freezing night. Complete: 'The ___ was well below zero.'
exercises.explanation: Temperature is how hot or cold it is at one moment; climate is the usual weather.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in order to describe a very cold day.
exercises.answer: The temperature fell to minus 10 degrees Celsius.
exercises.explanation: Below zero we say minus + number + degrees Celsius.

exercises.prompt: Which part of Switzerland is each place in?
